verdict.rationale: Model aliasing is a fair axis here, since RunAnywhere has an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (docs-4) and a CLI that loads local models (docs-6, docs-7). However, no evidence shows a way to assign a custom identifier or alias to a loaded model for use in API calls. The pack covers model downloads, the endpoint and the CLI, but never model naming or aliasing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
